ekr.views/authored/a-cursor-pages-a-neig.purpose: The hub's 1-hop neighbourhood pages as 250+249, 250+250 and 101+101 records at limit 250, the last with nothing remaining, and a cursor at the end answers an empty page.

ekr.views/authored/a-cursor-pages-the-ch.purpose: The hub's 1,201 seed changes page as 500 nodes, 101 nodes and 399 edges, then 201 edges at the default limit, and a cursor at the end answers an empty page.

ekr.views/authored/a-fact-quality-report.purpose: A judged sample's pass rate and its Wilson interval at the stated confidence, 9500 when none is stated, are the closed-form values, with the bounds exactly 0 and 1 where nothing or everything passed.

ekr.views/authored/a-fact-sample-is-the-.purpose: Drawing twice with one seed, size and revision draws the same facts; another seed, the head, a larger size and a type filter draw exactly the facts their draw keys name.

ekr.views/authored/a-lineage-lists-widen.purpose: A version made by WidenEdgeType lists its widened ends and one made by ModifyProperty its modified property, each from its own revision on, while added counts only new ids.

ekr.views/authored/a-node-is-not-found-a.purpose: A node created at revision 1 is not found at revision 0 by describe or expand, is described at revision 1, and the overview counts it from the revision that recorded it.

ekr.views/authored/a-process-map-counts-.purpose: Three tickets follow two variants at the seed and one at the head; naming the event types maps the log they give; an unknown name and selector are refused.

ekr.views/authored/a-property-a-subtype-.purpose: After a subtype redeclares an inherited property with another name and value kind, the projection lists one property entry per definition and the overview answers, while revision 0 still lists one.

ekr.views/authored/a-quality-report-coun.purpose: The quality of revisions 0, 1 and the head counts exactly the fixture's evidenced assertions, constrained properties and names shared within a type.

ekr.views/authored/a-retracted-assertion.purpose: An assertion added at revision 1 and retracted at revision 2 is absent at 0, Active at 1, and Retracted but still projected at 2.

ekr.views/authored/a-revision-beyond-the.purpose: A store at head 0 projects revision 0 when asked for it by number, and refuses revision 1 as not found, naming the request and the head.

ekr.views/authored/a-revision-since-list.purpose: Since revision 0 at 3 lists revision 1 to 3's 7 changes by kind, since 2 the one retraction, since 1 at 1 nothing, and since 0 at 2 the 6 changes of revisions 1 and 2.

ekr.views/authored/a-schema-evolution-pr.purpose: After one schema change the newest projection lists two versions and version 1's ontology, and a projection at revision 0 lists one version and version 0's ontology while the head is revision 1.

ekr.views/authored/a-search-lists-at-mos.purpose: A search matching 600 nodes answers 100 at limit 100 and 1 at limit 1, reporting all 600, and refuses a limit of 101 or 0.

ekr.views/authored/a-search-with-no-matc.purpose: A text in no name or alias answers no match; a text found only after lowercasing answers Folded matches; an Exact alias match of degree 1 comes before a Folded name match of degree 600.

ekr.views/authored/a-seed-only-store-pro.purpose: A store holding only its seed projects revision 0, with one schema version, one revision entry and no transaction id.

ekr.views/authored/a-timeline-refuses-ea.purpose: Hops 1 and 3 and limits 1 and 500 are answered; hops 0 or 4 and limit 0 or 501 are refused naming the first broken input, and an unknown subject answers no row.

ekr.views/authored/a-timeline-row-is-a-s.purpose: Each holder's row counts the events its walk reaches within 1, 2 and 3 hops, by day or by week, and a subject asked for alone lists its events.

ekr.views/authored/a-transaction-time-si.purpose: A transaction time before the seed lists all 12 changes from revision 0, and revision 1's own commit time lists only revisions 2 and 3.

ekr.views/authored/a-valid-time-since-li.purpose: A valid time of 1000 ms lists the 4 assertion changes valid after it and no node or edge, and 0 ms adds the seed's 2 assertions.

ekr.views/authored/an-add-evidence-is-li.purpose: Since revision 0 at 3 lists both added evidence entries once among 8 changes, since 2 the one of revision 3, and since 1 at 2 or a valid time none.

ekr.views/authored/an-assertion-about-an.purpose: The one assertion whose subject is an edge is projected under that edge.

ekr.views/authored/an-expansion-refuses-.purpose: Depth 0 and 2, limit 2,000 and edge_limit 5,000 are answered; depth 3 or -1, limit 2,001 or 0, edge_limit 5,001 or 0 and a negative cursor are refused, naming the first broken input.

ekr.views/authored/an-ocel-export-takes-.purpose: By the overview's rule step is the one event type at every revision; naming note leaves its undated node out; an unknown name is refused.

ekr.views/authored/an-overview-lists-at-.purpose: The overview lists 300 top nodes by default, 500 and 1 at the bounds, and refuses a limit of 501 or 0.

ekr.views/authored/an-unknown-seed-is-re.purpose: An expansion with one unknown seed among known ones is refused naming it, two unknown seeds name the first given, and describing an unknown node is refused naming it.

ekr.views/authored/changes-refuse-a-malf.purpose: A revision since of -1 is malformed before any bound, limit 0 or 2,001 and after -1 are refused, limit 2,000 and a valid time of -1 are answered, and since revision 9 is not found.

ekr.views/authored/code-names-reports-ea.purpose: A consumer's sources are reported for every planted type, property, canonical and alias name with file and line, runtime words flagged and ids never; the answer is independent of source order.

ekr.views/authored/named-event-time-reso.purpose: An inherited Timestamp supplies event time, missing values are counted, and historical names and ambiguous timestamp values are checked at the requested revision.

ekr.views/authored/seeded-evidence-is-pr.purpose: All three evidence records a seed admits are projected, and all three as retained.

ekr.views/authored/the-edge-limit-cuts-a.purpose: At edge_limit 100 the hub's neighbourhood pages as 102 nodes and 100 edges, then 100 and 100 starting with the edge the first page's last node closes.

ekr.views/authored/the-overview-derives-.purpose: The better-linked of two event types is the observation type, and the buckets turn from days to Monday weeks past a 120-day span.
